title: Goldena City Gems Villas
shortDescription: A small Goldena Group development of two-storey villas in Kamala on Phuket's west coast, each with a private pool.
description: A small Goldena Group development of two-storey villas in Kamala on Phuket's west coast, each with a private pool. Units found are three-bedroom homes of about 150 sqm built on compact plots of roughly 140-170 sqm. Still under construction with a handover expected between 2027 and early 2028.
